## **Welcome!**

Hi, I'm **Shreya Agarwal**, pursuing **Masters of IT in Business (MITB)** with a specialization in Data Analytics at **Singapore Management University (SMU)**.

This website showcases my coursework for ISSS608 - Visual Analytics and Applications, taught by **Professor Dr. Kam Tin Seong**. Here, you'll find projects, assignments, and insights gained throughout the course.

## **About the Course**

ISSS608 explores **data visualization techniques**, **analytics methodologies**, and the **practical application of visual analytics** in decision-making. Throughout this course, I primarily use **R** for data analysis and visualization, along with **R Shiny** for interactive applications and **Tableau** for dashboard development.

📌 **Course Material:** [ISSS608 AY2024-25 January Term](https://isss608-ay2024-25jan.netlify.app/)

Stay tuned as I update this space with my latest work! 🚀
